Based on my examination of the codebase, here are the three answers:

1. **Where is it guaranteed that no two articles share the same slug?**
   `prisma/schema.prisma :: slug @unique` (line 41)
   Database constraint on Article model slug field

2. **Where is it computed whether the requesting user follows an article's author?**
   `src/application/services/ArticleService.ts :: buildArticleResponse` (lines 190-192)
   Calls userRepository.isFollowing with current and author IDs

3. **Where is the authentication token verified on incoming requests?**
   `src/presentation/middleware/AuthMiddleware.ts :: authenticate` (line 25)
   Calls tokenService.verify on extracted Bearer token
